Name: Retexture the Z_InteriorESE.png of Upper Hall - PIF to fit the Colling's Elegant Town Interior
Author: PlumeQoQ
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]The asset used by this mod comes from [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/electroslime?gameId=1303]electroslime[/url]﻿.[/size]
All credit goes to the original creator. This will be removed upon request.
[size=1]Sadly, my Stardew Valley crashed (again!) while I was decorating, so I couldn't make a better showcase.[/size][size=3]
[/size][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]Introduction:[/size]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Retexture the Z_InteriorESE.png of[b] [/b][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25316][b]Upper Hall - PIF[/b][/url][size=3][b]  [/b]to fit the[b] [/b][/size][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15049]Colling's Elegant Town Interior[/url][size=3].[/size][/b][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]I created two versions matching [i]Elegant Town Interiors[/i]: one with the original stairs color and one with a lighter stairs color.[/size][/font]Feel free to download whichever you prefer.
[*]The wallpaper comes from my[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30047]Colorful Gradient Wallpaper[/url]﻿[/b]. It offers a unique feel and many color options. Feel free to download and enjoy!
[/list][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b]Installation:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Install all their required mods.[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip, and you will get a PNG image named '[color=#ff7700][b]Z_InteriorESE[/b][/color]'[/size]
[*][size=3]Place this image into [size=3]Stardew Valley\Mods[/size]\[CP] [PIF] Upper Hall[size=3]\assets[/size]. When it asks if you want to [/size][color=#ff7700][size=5]replace[/size][/color][size=3] the image, please click 'Yes.' [/size]
[*][size=5]You need to replace the picture [color=#ff7700]manually[/color][/size][size=3].[/size]﻿
[/list][/font]
